Dashboard.title: Cafe dashboard

Dashboard.expiring: {days, plural, =0 {Your subscription ends today} one {Your subscription ends in # day} other {Your subscription ends in # days}} (last paid day: {date}). Please contact support to renew it. After that day customers see a “temporarily unavailable” page.
Dashboard.loadError: This page could not be loaded.

DashboardHome.analyticsDetailed: Menu opens per day, per hour and per table

Categories.title: Categories
Categories.empty: No categories yet. Add the first one below.
Categories.deleteWarning: Its items are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
Categories.inactive: Your categories are kept. You can manage them again once the subscription is active.
Categories.reorderHint: Drag a category by its handle to change its place on the menu. The new order is saved at once.
Categories.dragInstructions: To move a category, press space or enter on its handle, move it with the up and down arrow keys, and press space or enter again to drop it. Press escape to cancel.

Items.title: Items
Items.noCategories: Add a category first: every item belongs to one.
Items.empty: No items in this category yet. Add the first one below.
Items.reorderHint: Drag an item by its handle to change its place in this category. The new order is saved at once.
Items.dragInstructions: To move an item, press space or enter on its handle, move it with the up and down arrow keys, and press space or enter again to drop it. Press escape to cancel.
Items.imageHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 2 MB.
Items.imagesKept: Images you added earlier are kept but hidden from customers until you upgrade.
Items.inactive: Your items are kept. You can manage them again once the subscription is active.

Qr.title: QR codes
Qr.tableCountHint: From 1 to 200. Tables you already have keep their codes, so printed codes keep working.
Qr.empty: No QR codes yet. Enter the number of tables and generate them.
Qr.inactive: Your tables and QR codes are kept. You can manage them again once the subscription is active.

Analytics.title: Analytics
Analytics.intro: How often customers opened your menu.
Analytics.total: {count, plural, one {menu open} other {menu opens}} in the last {days} days
Analytics.byHour: Menu opens per hour of the day
Analytics.noOpens: No menu opens in this period yet.
Analytics.needPro: On the Pro plan you also see at which hours and from which tables your menu is opened.
Analytics.approximate: The numbers are approximate. Each time the menu page loads counts as one open, so a reload counts again. Nothing about your customers is stored.
Analytics.inactive: Your numbers are kept. You can see them again once the subscription is active.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.slugHint: It is part of your menu address and of every printed QR code, so only support can change it.
Settings.customColor: Use my own color on the customer menu
Settings.colorHint: Without your own color, customers see the default brown.
Settings.colorKept: Your saved color {color} is kept, but customers see the default color until you upgrade.
Settings.logoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 2 MB. A transparent background stays transparent.
Settings.logoKept: Your logo is kept, but customers do not see it until you upgrade.
Settings.inactive: You can change your settings again once the subscription is active.

Password.title: Change password
Password.hint: At least 8 characters. Not only numbers, not a common password, and not like your email address. After the change you log in again.
Password.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
Password.changed: Your password was changed. Log in again with the new password.

ResetPassword.title: Set a new password
ResetPassword.intro: Choose a new password for your account. This link works once.
ResetPassword.hint: At least 8 characters. Not only numbers, not a common password, and not like your email address.
ResetPassword.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
ResetPassword.done: Your password was changed. Log in with the new password.
ResetPassword.noLink: This page needs a password reset link. Open the full link that support sent you.
ResetPassword.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.

AdminCafes.empty: No cafes yet. Add the first one.

AdminCreate.title: Add a cafe
AdminCreate.intro: A new cafe starts without an active subscription. Activate it on its page after payment.
AdminCreate.slugHint: Used in the customer menu address and in the printed QR codes, like tartus-coffee.
AdminCreate.passwordHint: Give this password to the owner; they can change it in Settings after logging in.

AdminCafe.title: Cafe details
AdminCafe.action: {action, select, activated {Subscription activated} deactivated {Subscription deactivated} plan_changed {Plan changed} renewed {Subscription renewed} expired {Subscription expired} other {{action}}}
AdminCafe.byDeleted: by an admin whose account was deleted
AdminCafe.daysLeft: {days, plural, =0 {Ends today} one {# day left} other {# days left}}
AdminCafe.expiresOnHint: The cafe stays active through this day. In the night after it, the subscription is deactivated automatically.
AdminCafe.renewText: Moves the last paid day to a later date after a new payment. The current period goes on without a gap.
AdminCafe.activateText: The menu becomes public and the owner can manage it. A new subscription period starts now.
AdminCafe.deactivateText: Customers see a “temporarily unavailable” page, and the owner cannot change the menu until it is active again. All its data is kept.
AdminCafe.notesHint: Saved in the billing history, for example: Paid 3 months in cash.
AdminCafe.slugWarning: Changing the address name stops every printed QR code of this cafe: old addresses do not lead to the new one.
AdminCafe.customColor: Own color for the customer menu
AdminCafe.colorHint: The color is kept on any plan, but customers see it only on a plan with custom branding.
AdminCafe.deleteWarning: The cafe, its owner's account and all its categories, items, tables, images and billing history are deleted. This cannot be undone, and the customer menu and QR codes stop working.
AdminCafe.resetLinkTitle: Password reset link for the owner
AdminCafe.resetLinkText: Makes a one-time link that lets <mail>{email}</mail> set a new password. The current password keeps working until the link is used.
AdminCafe.resetLinkHint: Nothing is sent automatically: copy the link and send it to the owner yourself, for example by WhatsApp.
AdminCafe.resetLinkWarning: Whoever has this link can set the password. Send it only to the owner.
